plugins.name: crewmarshal
plugins.description: Multi-agent delivery discipline: Claude architects and reviews while external executors implement, under adversarial review-to-GO and real-runtime verification. Extends superpowers.

plugins.name: crewmarshal
plugins.description: Multi-agent delivery discipline: the coordinator architects and reviews while external executors implement, under adversarial review-to-GO and real-runtime verification.

skills.name: adversarial-review-to-go
skills.description: Use when a spec, a plan, or an implemented diff needs an external adversarial reviewer — locks the reviewer to the altitude of what is being reviewed, converges diff findings to zero (GO), stops document review after one round, and re-verifies every finding on real source before acting.
headings: Lock the Reviewer to the Altitude
Ask for the Reverse Altitude Check
Every Finding Ships With Fix Options
skills.description_zh: 为规范、计划或实现差异引入外部对抗审查，保持审查层次与对象一致；代码差异问题收敛至零，文档审查一轮结束，每项发现均先回源核验。

skills.name: checkpoint-verification
skills.description: Use when accepting an executor's task or about to claim work done — refuses green tests as proof and requires inspecting the call-site and driving the real runtime path to catch missing wire-ups.
headings: Why Green E2E Is Not Enough
When Verification Catches What Tests Missed
skills.description_zh: 在验收执行者任务或宣布完成前，检查实际调用位置并驱动真实运行路径，发现测试通过仍可能遗漏的接线问题。

skills.name: concept-briefing
skills.description: Use as the first step on any new request, before design begins — locks a user-confirmed system profile (scale today and expected, users, trade-off priorities) and tiers the request to route it to the right amount of process, so mechanical work skips spec/plan entirely and layered work gets a phased roadmap instead of one giant plan.
headings: Roadmap — Layered Planning for Large Work
Handoff to the Rest of the Arc
skills.description_zh: 新请求设计前确认系统当前与预期规模、用户和权衡重点，按复杂度选择流程；机械操作可跳过规范与计划，分层工作形成阶段路线图。

skills.name: convention-commit-gate
skills.description: Use at every checkpoint review before committing — enforces centralized enums, no magic string/number literals, constant-based collection/model names, and the project's commit-message style.
skills.description_zh: 在每次提交前的检查点审查中落实集中枚举、避免魔法字符串与数字、集合和模型名称使用常量，并遵守项目提交消息风格。

skills.name: executor-context
skills.description: Use when dispatching work to executors or subagents and the same project conventions keep getting retyped into every prompt — maintains one fixed context file the coordinator writes and updates, so handoffs point at it instead of repeating scope boundaries, code conventions, test rules, and reporting requirements every time.
skills.description_zh: 为协调者维护统一执行上下文文件，将范围、代码惯例、测试规则和汇报要求集中管理，使执行者交接直接引用该文件。

skills.name: lessons-ledger
skills.description: Use before starting work in an area to retrieve only the lessons that apply to it, and right after a wrong diagnosis, a defect the tests missed, or an environment trap to record one — keeps hard-won lessons in a per-project ledger indexed by code area and work type, so past mistakes reach the next session and the executors without loading everything every time.
headings: <Tên — phát biểu như một luật, không phải kể sự cố>
Looking Up (before working in an area)
skills.description_zh: 按代码区域与工作类型建立项目经验账本，开始工作时检索相关经验，在误诊、测试遗漏缺陷或环境陷阱后记录教训，供后续会话与执行者使用。

skills.name: orchestrating-executors
skills.description: Use when a plan is ready and implementation will be delegated to external coding agents or subagents — covers knowing your workforce and what each has proven, choosing between a subagent and an external agent (confirming with the user the first time), role separation, quota management, one-task handoffs, asynchronous dispatch with a monitor on every run (no polling), parallel-run isolation, and the per-task checkpoint protocol.
headings: First time a project needs a subagent — confirm
A dispatch is complete only with evidence of all three
How to attach the monitor, in order of preference
After dispatch: work or wait, never poll
skills.description_zh: 计划完成后协调外部编码智能体或子智能体实施，涵盖人员能力、首次选择外部智能体的用户确认、角色分工、配额、单任务交接、异步监控、并行隔离和检查点验收。

skills.name: planning-for-delegation
skills.description: Use after a plan is drafted and before any task is handed to an executor — settles how detailed this project's plans are (asking once and recording it in the working agreement), keeps spec and plan at their own altitudes, and runs nine structural checks that catch the errors which send an executor confidently in the wrong direction.
headings: Spec and Plan Are Different Altitudes
How Detailed Should the Plan Be? Ask the Project.
skills.description_zh: 向执行者交接前确定并记录项目计划详略，区分规范与计划的层次，并进行九项结构检查，减少执行方向偏差。

skills.name: pointer-handoff
skills.description: Use at the start of any session on an ongoing project to recover where the work stands, and at the end of a session (or on any significant discovery) to record it — maintains a single short pointer file holding current state and the next action, so a fresh session with empty context resumes without re-deriving months of work from git log.
headings: Writing It (end of session, and mid-session on discovery)
skills.description_zh: 在持续项目会话开始恢复进度，结束或重要发现时更新一份简短指针文件，保存当前状态与下一步，帮助新会话接续。

skills.name: project-working-agreement
skills.description: Use before executing or dispatching work on a project, and whenever the user changes how the work should run — keeps one project file of working rules (stop after each task or continue, what coordinator/executor/reviewer may decide, plan detail, commit and language conventions), set up once by asking the user and reused by every later session and every executor.
headings: Reading It — before executing or dispatching
Setting It Up — missing file or missing groups
The cadence question is always asked explicitly
skills.description_zh: 建立并复用项目工作约定，记录任务后停止或继续、各角色决策范围、计划详略、提交与语言惯例，并在用户改变工作方式时更新。

skills.name: using-crewmarshal
skills.description: Use when starting delegated multi-agent delivery on a project — maps the full workflow arc and points to the right crewmarshal skill and superpowers skill at each stage.
headings: Principles That Hold Across All Stages
skills.description_zh: 作为项目委派多智能体交付入口，说明完整工作流程，并在各阶段指向相应crewmarshal和superpowers技能。
